voice_script.hook_line: Oh wow, look at this fluffy dandelion! All those tiny white seeds just waiting to fly away on the wind — like a hundred tiny parachutes!
voice_script.transition_line: You are now a Fluffy Expedition Explorer! Your mission is to find three more fluffy, fuzzy, or soft things around you. Let's see what fluffy treasures are hiding nearby!

rounds.prompt: Explorer, your first mission! Can you find something fluffy, fuzzy, or soft near you?
rounds.on_correct: What an amazing fluffy find! Look how soft and gentle it is — just like our dandelion friend! That's one treasure found!
rounds.on_incorrect: Great eye, Explorer! If we look really closely, there might be something soft or fuzzy about it. Every treasure counts!
rounds.on_silence: Take a look around you, Explorer. Maybe feel something nearby — is there anything soft, fluffy, or fuzzy? Even a leaf can feel soft!
rounds.hint: Try touching things around you — look for anything that feels soft, fuzzy, or fluffy like the dandelion!
rounds.on_wrong_photo: Hmm, that one doesn't feel very fluffy or soft. Would you like to look for something fuzzier?

rounds.prompt: Expedition report! We need our second fluffy find. Can you spot something else that's soft or fuzzy?
rounds.on_correct: Wonderful discovery! That's so soft and fluffy — our collection is growing! Two fluffy treasures found!
rounds.on_incorrect: Interesting find! You know what, if we imagine really hard, everything has a little bit of softness to it. Good exploring!
rounds.on_silence: You're doing great, Explorer. Maybe look at what you're wearing or sitting on — sometimes the fluffiest things are right next to us!
rounds.hint: Think about things you like to cuddle or touch because they're soft — a pillow, a blanket, or a pet!
rounds.on_wrong_photo: That's not quite fluffy enough. Can you find something that feels soft or fuzzy to the touch?

rounds.prompt: Last mission, Explorer! Find one more fluffy or soft thing to complete your expedition!
rounds.on_correct: You did it, Explorer! Three fluffy treasures found! What an incredible Fluffy Expedition — you're a natural explorer!
rounds.on_incorrect: That's a wonderful final find! Every explorer sees the world differently, and your collection is uniquely yours!
rounds.on_silence: We're almost there! Try looking up at the sky, or down at the ground. Fluffy things can be anywhere — even clouds count!
rounds.hint: Look up at the sky — clouds are the fluffiest things of all! Or try finding a soft flower or fuzzy leaf.
rounds.on_wrong_photo: Almost! That one isn't quite fluffy. One more look — can you find something really soft?

voice_script.closing_speech: Congratulations, Fluffy Expedition Explorer! You found three amazing soft treasures, all connected by their fluffiness — just like our dandelion! A tiny dandelion seed and all your fluffy finds share something special. That's the beauty of Connection — finding how different things are linked together!
voice_script.tomorrow_hook: Next time you're outside, keep your explorer senses open — fluffy and soft things are hiding everywhere, waiting to be discovered!
voice_script.synthesis_speech: Now let's look at all your fluffy treasures together! Each one is soft and gentle, but they all feel a little different — some are fuzzy, some are silky, some are puffy. Isn't it wonderful how softness comes in so many different forms?
voice_script.early_exit_speech: What a wonderful fluffy expedition we had! You found some amazing soft treasures. The fluffy things will be waiting for your next adventure!
